brilliant banh mi
Jan 2024 • Couples
I can confirm it’s up there with the best. Based off a bloggers website, this was apparently the place to go for banh mi in Hanoi. To be fair it was incredible - delicious, great quality, good proportions of ingredients. A bit of fat on some of the meat which I’m not keen on but was able to pick this off and otherwise amazing. Boyfriend absolutely loved it. Gorgeous blue Greek style decor which stands out in Hanoi. Prices reasonable and service great.
